steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add an item for the vendor quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the buyer and vendor flow.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Assert that the event was published successfully.
Continue in the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the Technical stage first to verify RFQ-only terms are not shown there.
Assert the first RFQ-only clause is absent from the Technical stage.
Assert the second RFQ-only clause is absent from the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should be presented.
Assert the first optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Assert the second optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept the first clause in the vendor portal.
Accept the second clause in the vendor portal.
Submit the vendor's quote after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to confirm the response is visible.
Assert that the buyer sees the vendor's submitted RFQ response.
Attempt to observe the buyer-side accepted state for the terms; the exact buyer-side representation is not catalog-defined.
